例句

  1. Humans learn to express what they think by the age of five or six.
    人類到五、六歲的時候就學會表達自己的想法。
  2. My little brother learned to ride a bike last year.
    我弟弟去年學會騎腳踏車。
  3. Babies learn to walk at about one year old.
    嬰兒大約一歲的時候學會走路。
  4. I learned to swim when I was seven.
    我七歲的時候學會游泳。
  5. You will learn to cook if you help your mother in the kitchen.
    你如果在廚房幫你媽媽，就會學會做菜。
  6. Children learn to share toys in kindergarten.
    小孩在幼稚園學會分享玩具。
  7. She is learning to play the piano.
    她正在學彈鋼琴。
  8. Tom never learned to drive a car.
    Tom 從來沒有學會開車。
  9. I can't believe what he said.
    我不敢相信他說的話。
  10. Please show me what you bought.
    請給我看你買的東西。
  11. This is what I wanted.
    這就是我想要的東西。
  12. Write down what the teacher says.
    把老師說的話寫下來。
  13. I don't understand what you mean.
    我不懂你的意思。
  14. I'll buy you what you want for your birthday.
    你生日想要什麼，我就買給你。
  15. We ate what my grandmother made for us.
    我們吃了我奶奶為我們做的東西。
  16. Ann is always honest about what she feels.
    Ann 對自己的感受總是很誠實。
  17. Please finish your report by Friday.
    請在星期五之前完成你的報告。
  18. I have to be home by ten.
    我十點之前要到家。
  19. The train will arrive in Osaka by noon.
    火車會在中午之前到大阪。
  20. Most children can read by the age of seven.
    大部分的小孩到七歲的時候就會閱讀。
  21. By the end of the year, I want to save enough money for a trip.
    我想在年底之前存夠旅行的錢。
  22. Can you send me the photos by tomorrow?
    你可以在明天之前把照片寄給我嗎？
  23. Please be at the station by six.
    請在六點之前到車站。
  24. She learned to speak English by the age of ten.
    她到十歲的時候就學會說英文。
  25. Children learn to say what they want by the age of three.
    小孩到三歲的時候就學會說出自己想要什麼。
  26. I learned to write what I think in English in high school.
    我在高中學會用英文寫出自己的想法。
  27. It is not easy to express what you feel in a foreign language.
    用外語表達自己的感受不容易。
  28. My son learned to use chopsticks by the age of four.
    我兒子四歲之前就學會用筷子。
  29. Don't worry about what other people think.
    不要在意別人的想法。
  30. Please let me know what you think by Friday.
    請在星期五之前讓我知道你的想法。
  31. We are learning French at school.
    我們在學校學法文。
  32. My father learned Chinese cooking from my grandmother.
    我爸爸跟我奶奶學中式料理。
  33. That's what I need.
    那正是我需要的。
